title: VINCIE-NExT: Unlocking Video Editing from Images via In-Context Modeling
title_zh: VINCIE-NExT: 通过上下文建模从图像中解锁视频编辑

paragraphs.en: VINCIE-NExT 是一种新框架，能够通过上下文视觉演示将图像编辑能力转移到视频编辑，从而绕过大规模配对视频编辑数据的需求。 Building a capable video editor remains significantly harder than a video generator: editing requires (source, instruction, edited) triplets that are prohibitively expensive to annotate and difficult to synthesize at scale, whereas image editing has already reached maturity with millions of such pairs readily available. In this work, we introduce VINCIE-NExT, a unified framework that transfers editing capability from images to videos through in-context visual demonstrations, alleviating the need for large-scale paired video editing data. VINCIE-NExT decomposes video editing into a structured chain of composable sub-tasks (Video -> Image -> Image -> Video), routing editing intent through the image domain and enabling scalable joint training from heterogeneous image and video corpora under a unified diffusion objective. An image editing pair, synthesized by the model or supplied by the user, is prepended as an in-context visual demonstration that serves as a spatial appearance blueprint for every output frame. To ground appearance edits across the interleaved context, we introduce a novel position encoding that links image demonstrations and video frames in a shared spatial coordinate system, enabling pixel-faithful propagation of appearance changes to every output frame. Chain-of-Editing further provides principled test-time scaling: by executing the sub-task chain as progressive diffusion stages, editing quality can be improved by investing additional compute without retraining. Comprehensive experiments on OpenVE-Bench demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across diverse editing categories, with ablations confirming the effectiveness of each component.
paragraphs.zh: VINCIE-NExT 是一种新框架，它能够通过上下文视觉演示将图像编辑能力迁移到视频编辑中，从而无需依赖大规模配对的视频编辑数据。构建一个功能强大的视频编辑器仍然比构建视频生成器困难得多：视频编辑需要（源视频、指令、编辑后视频）的三元组，而标注这些三元组的成本极高，且难以大规模合成；相比之下，图像编辑已经成熟，并且有数百万个这样的配对数据可供直接使用。 在本研究中，我们提出了 VINCIE-NExT——一个统一的框架，它通过上下文中的视觉演示将编辑能力从图像迁移到视频，从而减少了对大规模配对视频编辑数据的需求。 VINCIE-NExT 将视频编辑分解为一系列结构化的可组合子任务链（视频 -> 图像 -> 图像 -> 视频），通过图像域传递编辑意图，并使得在统一的扩散目标下，能够基于异构的图像和视频语料库进行可扩展的联合训练。 由模型合成或由用户提供的图像编辑配对会被作为上下文中的视觉演示前置添加，为每个输出帧提供空间外观的蓝图。 为了在交错上下文中锚定外观编辑，我们引入了一种新颖的位置编码方法，它将图像演示和视频帧链接到共享的空间坐标系中，从而使得外观变化能够以像素级保真度传播到每个输出帧。 “编辑链”机制还为实现推理时的可扩展性提供了理论依据：通过将子任务链作为渐进式扩散阶段执行，无需重新训练即可通过增加计算资源来提升编辑质量。 在 OpenVE-Bench 上进行的全面实验表明，该方法在各种编辑类别中均达到了当前最先进的性能，消融研究也验证了每个组件的有效性。
